claims.evidence: No manufacturer name, part number, or vehicle markings are visible in the photo; fitment cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Headlights may not actually fit a 2003-2007 Honda Accord (mismatched or misrepresented model).
risks.proof: Close-up of any embossed part number, OEM logo, or a side-by-side fit comparison with a known Accord headlight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/unverified-fitment aftermarket headlight, not as confirmed Accord OEM part.

risks.risk: Lens may be cracked, scratched, or fogged, reducing value.
risks.proof: Close-up clear shot of each lens from multiple angles including edges.

risks.risk: Bulbs, wiring, or connectors may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the assembly powered on showing both low and high beam, plus turn signal lighting.

risks.risk: Mounting tabs/brackets could be broken, affecting installation.
risks.proof: Close-up of all mounting points and tabs on the rear of each housing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming broken mounts needing repair.

risks.risk: The two headlights may not be a true matching pair (different trims/years).
risks.proof: Side-by-side comparison photo showing identical part numbers or design features.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mismatched/single-unit value rather than pair value.

risks.risk: Unclear if the visible tail-light assembly is included in this sale, affecting total value.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and a clear photo of the tail-light unwrapped and included in the listing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as headlights only, tail-light excluded.

proof_requests: Close-up of any part number or OEM marking on the back of each headlight.
Video showing the headlights powered on (low beam, high beam, turn signal).
Close-up of lens surfaces for cracks, scratches, or fogging.
Close-up of mounting tabs/brackets on both units.
Clarify whether the tail-light assembly is included in the sale.
response.reason: The witness confirms a used pair of headlight assemblies, so the item can be priced at worst case for unverified fitment, condition, and functionality until the seller provides supporting proof.
